name: hcapp_getBlockedHashers
description: The caller's blocked hashers (E9.F1.S16), for the Blocked hashers settings screen where a block is undone. Read-only. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 126, @param NULL); @userId comes from the token and the WHERE is scoped to it, so a hasher only ever sees their own blocks. A block is an HC.HasherFriendMap row with Ignore = 1; newest first.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (a NULL is refused by ValidateAppAuth as 'Device not registered').

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail alone and the SP returns. No compact envelope.

rowsets.name: BlockedHashers
rowsets.description: On success: one row per blocked hasher, ORDER BY HasherFriendMap.updatedAt DESC. Empty when the caller has blocked nobody. WHERE f.UserId = @userId AND f.Ignore = 1 (no filter on f.Removed or h.Removed: a GDPR-deleted hasher still appears as 'Deleted User').

columns.name: PublicHasherId
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) — the blocked hasher's public id in upper case; the app lowercases it on arrival (lowerGuidsInPlace).

columns.name: DisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — persisted computed column honouring NameDisplayPreference.

columns.name: BlockedAt
columns.description: HasherFriendMap.updatedAt — when the block was last set (column added by db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-29_hasher_block.sql).

sideEffects: None on success. INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error (CATCH, line 48).

codeSmells.detail: Line 39 returns PublicHasherId as UPPER(...). Ids are lowercase everywhere in the app (CLAUDE.md 'Ids are lowercase, everywhere'); this relies on the adHoc reply door lowercasing it. Harmless today, but a reader that compares before that door runs would match nothing.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
